_note: ARCHE's trail (docs/survival_world.md section 7, calls 62 and 66; docs/survival_enclave.md): the pieces of the story behind the fall. Each world's seed lays them across ARCHE's sites (the lab, the sealed level under the military base, the bunkers, the relay stations, the failed quarantine camp; the survivor who worked there; the enclave officer who knows part; the broadcasts on ARCHE's frequency) in its own order (ArcheTrail.lay). Reading one adds a journal entry and a map mark (and marks where the trail leads next); a piece with code true carries a bunker's door code. theory: which of the two contradictory accounts the piece supports (leak: an accident, the serum a vaccine that came too late; release: a field trial that was authorised); the trail never settles it. Text placeholders: {code} a bunker's door code, {bunker} that bunker's name, {next} where the trail leads, {freq} the frequency. All text Proposed: tune freely.
seal: the ARCHE seal: a grey arch over a blue cross-hatched shield, APPLIED RESEARCH AND CONTAINMENT, HEALTH AND EPIDEMICS around the rim

sealed_level.name: the sealed level under the base

pieces.title: Memo ARC-114: containment posture
pieces.text: CP-3 effective 0600. All HALYARD material to cold storage. Do not discuss the Harrow incident outside the SCIF. Further guidance follows by courier. The trail points on: {next}.

pieces.title: Lab terminal: centrifuge log
pieces.text: RUN 41: donor serum, titre insufficient. RUN 42: donor D-7 (non-converting), titre holds at 4 C. Recommend IMMEDIATE scale-up. Request denied, see board minutes. Facilities note for {bunker}: keypad reset to {code}.

pieces.title: Tape: Dr. Ilse Varga, day 3
pieces.text: It was never meant to leave the cold room. Somebody signed it out for transport and the paperwork says the transport never happened. We're working the serum around the clock. If you're hearing this, look for the ones who don't turn.

pieces.title: Sealed level access roster
pieces.text: Level B3 access, revised. Escorted visitors only. Alternate egress through {bunker} (code {code}). Anyone on this list not accounted for by Friday is presumed exposed.

pieces.title: B3 terminal: Project HALYARD summary
pieces.text: HALYARD phase IV: open-population observation, three sites, authorised under annex C. Projected exposure contained by geography. Projection revised twice. Projection withdrawn.

pieces.title: Tape: field team, Harrow
pieces.text: ...the trucks were already here when the first cases came in. They knew. They had the tents up and the forms printed with our town's name on them before anyone was sick.

pieces.title: Quarantine Camp 2: intake sheet
pieces.text: Intake 1-412. Bitten: segregate. Non-converting after 7 days: transfer to ARCHE custody, do not record. Supplies cached at {bunker}, door {code}.

pieces.title: Relay terminal: traffic log
pieces.text: Outbound to all stations on {freq}: RECALL, RECALL. Station log: {bunker} keypad {code} confirmed. Next relay: {next}.

pieces.title: Broadcast: the numbers
pieces.text: A woman's voice on {freq}, reading numbers in fives, then: 'ARCHE stations acknowledge.' Nobody acknowledges.

pieces.title: Broadcast: the recall
pieces.text: On {freq}: 'All ARCHE personnel report to the port for extraction. Bring your badges. Bring your donors.' It repeats every hour.

pieces.title: Bunker manifest
pieces.text: Stores: 90 days for 12. Medical: full. Cold chain: serum x 4 (see fridge). Sister site {bunker}, door {code}. Do not open from inside before the all-clear.

pieces.title: Tape: the last shift
pieces.text: We sealed the door at 0400 with eleven inside. Two were bitten. We didn't know yet. If you found this, I'm sorry about what's behind the second door.

pieces.title: Bunker terminal: donor registry
pieces.text: Non-converting subjects: 3 confirmed. One escaped transfer. Blood type and marker on file. Serum requires a live donor, a centrifuge and a working cold chain. Annex: {bunker} {code}.

pieces.title: Board minutes (copy)
pieces.text: The Board notes the field observation proceeded as authorised. The Board notes the outcome exceeded the model. The Board directs that the record show the release was an accident.

pieces.title: The technician's story
pieces.text: I washed glassware on B3 for six years. They didn't release it. Somebody stole a box and dropped it. The serum works. I've seen it work. You need one of the ones who don't turn.

pieces.title: What the officer knows
pieces.text: We guarded their doors. Nobody told us what was behind them. The week before it started they had us move the trucks out to Harrow. We thought it was a drill.

fragments: An ARCHE property tag on an empty case. The seal, and nothing else.
A shift rota in acronyms: CP-3, B3, SCIF, D-7. Someone has circled D-7 twice.
A page of a manual: 'Cold chain integrity is the mission.' The rest is torn away.
A badge photo of a smiling woman. ARCHE, Level 2. The clip is broken.
